reviews.comment: Lectures are understandable and clear. Takes time to answer questions students have during class. Provides lecture notes on canvas. Provides practice problems/tests before every test that are similar to the real thing. Pay attention in class and do the practice problems provided to get an easy A.

Great prof. Hw's all on chegg and they're nothing like the tests. Gives out a test review that if you do you should get a 90+ on every test knowing the process of each of the like four or five problems. Should be an easy A. Didn't really go to lecture but he has very good notes he posts that I would download and look at examples that were inside.
provides a lot of exampels one con he always puts in a tricky question havent seen before on exams
The homework is difficult but he gives fairly easy tests. Lectures are slightly difficult to follow but the material is not impossible to learn.

He truly cares about what he teaches and this made me excited and willing to learn the material. I would say that he does already teach on pre written notes and can go really quickly through notes so I found his uploaded zoom lecture videos much more helpful than going to class. I do like the material and I think he did a good job lecturing.
Very nice, take him

He breaks down concepts well for us since it is our first time in a CHEN class. The midterms are common and are not like his practice exams, so they were both tough. He allows us to bring pages of notes and is nice with partial credit. The weekend quizzes are great practice to help understand material better and his final is like the practice exam.

Overall Gagnon is a great professor. His lectures are very informative however can feel a little rushed at times. While the exams are difficult he lets you bring in multiple pages of notes. He's a lenient grader and gives a lot of partial credit. The HW is often much more difficult than the exams and can take quite a long time to finish.

Gagnon is an amazing professor for this course. He makes it very easy for students, as he has incredibly detailed lectures posted for every topic and will even make bonus videos if asked for. 
He gives students a great idea if what will be on the exams, and also curves them up. It is easy to succeed in his class.

CHEN 204 during Fall Semester. Prof Gagnon provides very detailed handwritten notes that he discusses during lecture. The Wiley homework is very challenging at times. Allotted recitation time is provided once a week. A few pages of handwritten notes are allowed for each each exam. Prof Gagnon grades very leniently. Very helpful through email!

Took online during second COVID semester. Altered his tests to all multiple choice, and was super reasonable. Homework was harder than the tests. Had a gamer-like setup for recording lectures, and is the creator of the Gagnometer 3000, patent pending. Absoulute Chad.

Dr. Gagnon is such a cool professor. He was the reason I felt confident in chemical engineering as my choice of major. As the class was learning totally new concepts, the material was somewhat difficult, but Professor Gagnon delivered it really well. He really does his best to make sure you can succeed if you put in the effort.

Professor Gagnon is a very good teacher and a very nice person! The exams are hard, but you can still do very well on them if you study the practice exams and in-class examples. He records all the lectures so you can go back to rewatch them. He also makes helpful videos for us when there's a topic that many students are confused on.

For an introduction to ChemE, Gagnon does a great job at easing concepts in and making sure you are able to complete the problems. The hw takes a lot of time but is doable and prepares you well for anything. Super nice and helpful professor and a VERY generous grader.

Professor Gagnon is probably the best option for this course. He helps ease students into ChemE and is very fair with his exams. Exam averages are a lot higher than other profs for this course. He is very accessible and will go over topics you don't understand if you ask him to. He does teach fast in class and it can be hard to keep up at times

Gagnon is a great professor. If there is a topic he gets a lot of emails about students not understanding, he'll make an oddly high production value video for them to watch outside of class that explains the topic so the students can understand it. He really cares about his students. There is a HW assignment every week and it can take hours to do.

Probably the best professor I've ever had. Listened to students and wrote us additional practice when we said it might be helpful, as well as changed his testing procedure to accommodate us. Found interesting videos and experiments to show off in recitation. Open note tests, at least for online class.

The best professor ever. Took him for chen 205 and he was such a good prof. He cares about his students so much. Not hard to get an A but the material is very hard. He makes the tests very fair and prepares you well for them. Go to lectures and do your homework and you will do well.

Literally the best teacher at A and M. I don't think anyone cares mores about there students than Dr. Gagnon. He really makes sure you get the information you need and answers any and all questions. He goes a little fast though so be aware

Professor Gagnon is hands down the best professor I've taken thus far. He genuinely cares for his students and strives to ensure that everyone understands the content. He even makes his own videos outside of class to cover commonly misunderstood topics. Meanwhile, all my other profs can't even figure out how to mute people on zoom.

Dr. Gagnon is the best professor I have had so far during college. This includes it being online. He has clearly shown his care for his students and his role in education. If you have the option to take him, do it. I have never seen a professor send more thorough emails, be more adaptive, or gain more respect from their students as a mass.
Taking 204 with him was the best decision. He really cares about his students and wants make sure everyone does well in the class.

He is a professor that makes you work for the grade, but he also cares if you actually learn the material. His tests are designed around topics and examples he covers in class or they are over topics that are covered extensively. He is my favorite professor because he does care about his students, and work and that makes the class enjoyable.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Gagnon teaches slower than the other 204 professors, but it is helpful as he takes the time to make sure his students understand the material. The Lectures are nor mandatory but are helpful. The recitation is mandatory as problems are assigned. The exams are easy if you read the book and attend the lecture. He is a very nice prof, solid choice.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Lectures are not mandatory, but recitations are graded on attendance and quizzes. He goes over lots of example problems in his lectures and moves at a different pace, focusing on the more important material. His tests aren't easy, but the problems are similar to the ones in the textbook. There is also an extra credit project for 10 pts on the final
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Gagnon is the best prof to take for chen 204 by far. the nicest, and most fair exams. a lot of my other friends who took another prof had exams outside the scope of what they learned in class. for Gagnon, that is not the case. what you see in class is what you will see on the test. strongly recommend him

Dr. Gagnon rarely responds to emails, but he is very helpful in his office hours. Tries not to make the class horrible for the students. Gives hints on the exams, and pulls the questions from the homework. Not the best lecturer, but he does want to help his students learn and understand the tough course material. Overall, a solid prof!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS
